text:
sara_sales: Quick sync - Polybridge wants to migrate from CompetitorX. They asked for a 4-week POC to validate prompt parity, security posture, and a clear cost delta. They already sent a security questionnaire link: https://polybridge.internal/sec-2026.pdf

jordan_se: Got it. Minimal POC scope proposal: 1) 500 representative requests for A/B testing, 2) mapping of function-calling and streaming semantics, 3) run 10k parallel comparison traffic at target qps, 4) parity acceptance: >=95% top-1 semantic match or explainable delta.

kevin_polybridge: Goals from buyer: identical results for critical routes, fallback to cheaper models for non-critical paths, predictable monthly bill. Expect peak ~150 qps, avg completion ~220 tokens, ~60% streaming. Target <200ms median for short prompts.

marta_security: On security: they require KMS and audit logs. Clarify if BYOK is mandatory for initial POC or only for production. Also confirm SIEM forwarding (we support syslog or direct S3 export).

nisha_legal: We'll need deletion workflow for cached KV and a data residency clause. Also flag indemnity and export-control items for redlines.

ryan_account: Ballpark hosted pricing: example model ~ $0.0035/1k prompt + $0.008/1k completion. 1M tokens ~ $2k-3k/month depending on split and caching. Dedicated = commit + lower unit. Offer 20% POC discount. Need concurrency to quote Dedicated.

jordan_se: Technical note: function-calling events differ from CompetitorX; we'll build a lightweight mapping shim in the POC to normalise callbacks. We'll also enable prefix/KV caching to reduce token usage. For validation use a comparator that runs levenshtein + embedding-similarity and produces a simple pass/fail.

infra-bot: POC ticket created: POC-2719. Staging infra requested. ETA provisioning: 2 business days. Please upload CIDR and admin IAM role.

sara_sales: Action items: @kevin_polybridge upload 500 sample payloads and answer questionnaire to POC-2719; @jordan_se author mapping shim + test plan; @marta_security and @nisha_legal prepare artifacts and contract markups. Schedule 30m sync Fri 9am PT.

kevin_polybridge: Uploading samples today and confirming CIDR. Thanks! :thumbsup:
